name: Wayfarer

attributes.description:
The bow remembers roads no living traveller has walked.

Windstride: 12% chance on a successful normal weapon attack to gain 40 movement speed points for 3 seconds. Adds to haste without curing paralysis. Cooldown: 12 seconds.
Legendary weapon cooldowns are shared by your character. Extra damage is based on the original attack before critical bonuses and mitigation; armor, resistance and player damage rules still apply.
